label: Google Workspace
description: Official Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, and Sheets integrations with app-specific accounts.

apps.label: Gmail
apps.description: Search threads, read messages, send mail, and manage labels.

apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: List events, create events, update events, and check free/busy.

apps.label: Drive
apps.description: Search Drive, upload and download files, and create share links.

apps.label: Docs
apps.description: Read, create, append to, and replace text in Google Docs.

apps.label: Sheets
apps.description: Read ranges, update values, append rows, and create spreadsheets.

tools.name: google_workspace_gmail_search_threads
tools.description: Search Gmail threads for the connected Google Workspace account. When multiple Gmail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

query.description: Gmail search query using standard Gmail search syntax. All operators are optional — pass an empty string to search all mail. Examples: "is:unread", "from:someone@example.com", "subject:invoice", "is:read newer_than:30d", "label:work", "has:attachment".

max_results.description: Maximum number of threads to return (default 10).

tools.name: google_workspace_gmail_get_thread
tools.description: Read a Gmail thread (read or unread) with headers and decoded plain-text bodies. Use this after google_workspace_gmail_search_threads to fetch the full content of a thread. thread_id comes from search results. When multiple Gmail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

thread_id.description: Gmail thread ID, obtained from google_workspace_gmail_search_threads results.

tools.name: google_workspace_gmail_get_message
tools.description: Read a single Gmail message (read or unread) with headers and decoded body. message_id can come from search results or from messages inside a thread fetched via google_workspace_gmail_get_thread. When multiple Gmail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

message_id.description: Gmail message ID, obtained from search results or a thread's message list.

tools.name: google_workspace_gmail_list_labels
tools.description: List Gmail labels available to the connected account. When multiple Gmail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_gmail_send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the connected Gmail account. When multiple Gmail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

thread_id.description: Optional Gmail thread ID to reply in-thread.

tools.name: google_workspace_gmail_modify_thread_labels
tools.description: Add or remove Gmail labels from a thread, optionally archiving it by removing INBOX. When multiple Gmail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

add_label_names.description: Label names to add. Supports system labels (e.g. "STARRED", "IMPORTANT", "UNREAD") and custom user labels. Use "UNREAD" to mark a thread as unread.

remove_label_names.description: Label names to remove. Supports system labels (e.g. "UNREAD", "STARRED", "IMPORTANT", "INBOX") and custom user labels. Use "UNREAD" to mark a thread as read.

archive.description: When true, remove the INBOX label.

tools.name: google_workspace_gmail_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Gmail API request for advanced Gmail operations not covered by the dedicated Gmail tools. When multiple Gmail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

path.description: Gmail API path or URL, e.g. /gmail/v1/users/me/settings/sendAs.

tools.name: google_workspace_calendar_list_events
tools.description: List or search Google Calendar events for the connected account. When time_min is supplied, the default starts_within_window mode returns only timed events whose real start is at or after time_min (and before time_max when present). Multi-day events that started earlier and merely overlap the window are omitted unless include_ongoing is true. All-day events are omitted unless include_all_day is true. For reminders about events starting soon, keep both options false and decide only from upcomingTimedEvents. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

time_min.description: RFC3339 lower bound for the overlap window. Also separates already-running timed events from events that start in the window.

time_max.description: RFC3339 exclusive upper bound for an event start.

include_ongoing.description: Include timed events that started before time_min and are still running. Defaults to false for bounded windows.

include_all_day.description: Include all-day and multi-day date events. Defaults to false for bounded windows.

tools.name: google_workspace_calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a Google Calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_calendar_update_event
tools.description: Update fields on an existing Google Calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for updated start/end values.

tools.name: google_workspace_calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Delete a Google Calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_calendar_free_busy
tools.description: Check Google Calendar free/busy windows across calendars. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

calendar_ids.description: Calendar IDs to query, defaults to primary.

tools.name: google_workspace_calendar_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Google Calendar API request for advanced calendar operations not covered by the dedicated tools. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

path.description: Calendar API path or URL, e.g. /calendar/v3/users/me/calendarList.

tools.name: google_workspace_drive_search_files
tools.description: List or search Drive files visible to the connected account. When multiple Drive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

query.description: Drive search query. Empty returns recent files.

tools.name: google_workspace_drive_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file from your workspace to Google Drive. When multiple Drive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

file_path.description: The file to upload: a path in your workspace or an owned artifact.

tools.name: google_workspace_drive_download_file
tools.description: Download a Drive file to a local destination. When multiple Drive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

destination_path.description: Absolute local file path to write.

tools.name: google_workspace_drive_export_file
tools.description: Export a native Google file like Docs or Sheets to a local file. When multiple Drive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

destination_path.description: Absolute local file path to write.

tools.name: google_workspace_drive_create_share_link
tools.description: Create a Drive sharing permission and return the resulting link. When multiple Drive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

role.description: Permission role, e.g. reader or writer.

type.description: Permission type, e.g. anyone or user.

tools.name: google_workspace_drive_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Google Drive API request for advanced file, folder, permission, comment, revision, and shared drive operations. When multiple Drive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

path.description: Drive API path or URL, e.g. /drive/v3/files or /drive/v3/files/{fileId}/comments.

tools.name: google_workspace_docs_get_document
tools.description: Read a Google Doc and return its plain-text content. When multiple Docs accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_docs_create_document
tools.description: Create a Google Doc, optionally with initial content. When multiple Docs accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_docs_append_text
tools.description: Append text to the end of a Google Doc. When multiple Docs accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_docs_replace_text
tools.description: Replace matching text throughout a Google Doc. When multiple Docs accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_docs_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Google Docs API request for advanced document batchUpdate operations not covered by the dedicated tools. When multiple Docs accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

path.description: Docs API path or URL, e.g. /v1/documents/{documentId}:batchUpdate.

tools.name: google_workspace_sheets_get_values
tools.description: Read a range from a Google Sheet. When multiple Sheets accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_sheets_update_values
tools.description: Overwrite a range in a Google Sheet. When multiple Sheets accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_sheets_append_rows
tools.description: Append rows to a Google Sheet range. When multiple Sheets accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_sheets_create_spreadsheet
tools.description: Create a new Google Spreadsheet. When multiple Sheets accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

tools.name: google_workspace_sheets_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Google Sheets API request for advanced spreadsheet, sheet, chart, formatting, pivot table, and batchUpdate operations. When multiple Sheets accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

path.description: Sheets API path or URL, e.g. /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate.
